description: A disbursement register with mixed INR units, three date formats, blank separators, and repeated headers.

questions.question: What is the total disbursed amount? Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
questions.trap: Treating lakh/crore suffixes as literal numbers or dropping formatted strings.

questions.question: How much was disbursed to Maternal & Child Health from 1 April through 30 June 2025 inclusive? Dates are YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY (day first), or D Mon YYYY. Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
questions.trap: Parsing 03/04/2025 as March 4 instead of 3 April.

questions.question: How many Odisha records have a non-zero amount? Treat blank, '-' and NA as zero and count records, not distinct amounts.
questions.trap: Counting missing-value markers as non-zero text entries.

questions.question: Which donor or scheme has the highest total disbursed amount? Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
What percentage of the total disbursed amount went to Karnataka? Return a percentage from 0 to 100. Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
questions.trap: Returning a fraction instead of a percentage or omitting crore rows.

questions.question: Which programme received the highest total disbursed amount? Use INR; L/lakh = 100,000, Cr = 10,000,000, k = 1,000, and treat blank, '-' and NA amounts as zero.
questions.trap: Including repeated header rows as data or failing to normalize units.
